questions.passage: Maya waited in line to check in for her flight. Her expectations about her European backpacking trip were really high. She had been looking forward to the trip for a year. She couldn't wait to visit museums in Madrid and see the Eiffel Tower at night in Paris. As she stood in line, she could feel those experiences were finally so close. When she approached the counter, the airline employee asked to see her passport. Maya reached into her pocket and felt nothing. She realized she had left her passport at home. Her plans were ruined. She was heartbroken, knowing she could not board the flight and had to __________ her dream trip.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 그녀는 비행기에 탈 수 없어서 꿈꾸던 여행을 __________해야 했다.
det.analysis:
④ delay: had to delay her dream trip 원문 일치 ←정답
① board(탑승하다): could not board — 탑승 불가 맥락
② cancel(취소하다): delay(연기)이지 cancel이 아님
③ enjoy(즐기다): 즐길 수 없는 상황
det.tip: delay = 미루다/연기하다. cancel과 다름. 여행이 취소가 아닌 연기
